Subject: PO issued (12345) — SKU codes don't match onboarding form / spend cap too low

Hi Markus,

Quick heads up — we received the PO (Redwood PO 12345) that was generated for our BrightGrid onboarding, but the line items on the ledger don’t match the SKU codes we submitted in the onboarding form. Specifically:

- Submitted SKU BG-API-XL (3 units) -> PO shows BG-API (no -XL)
- Submitted SKU BG-SUPPORT-PREM (12 months) -> PO split across two lines, quantities halved

Also, the spend cap on the PO is $75,000 but our procurement request and signed SOW call for $110,000 for the first year. We need a corrected PO before we can finalize account activation and start the data migration.

I attached the onboarding form and a copy of the PO we received. Can you advise if you can reissue the PO with: a) corrected SKU codes matching the form, and b) a provisional spend cap increase (or temporary uplift) while finance processes the full allocation?

Best,
Samir Das

Thanks Samir — and thanks for the clear breakdown. Tagging Monica (procurement ops) and Olga (finance) to own the fix.

Monica / Olga — can you confirm whether we should:
1) Re-issue PO 12345 with corrected SKUs and a temporary spend uplift to $120,000 (so BrightGrid can proceed); or
2) Issue a new PO number (e.g., 12345-R1) and mark 12345 as superseded?

Preference would be to avoid creating a new vendor record if we can keep the same PO number and add an audit note (simpler for the vendor). If we re-use 12345, please include a clear reason code and the original issue timestamp in the audit trail.

Samir — if you can confirm acceptance of either approach I’ll get procurement to draft the corrected PO and loop in finance for approval. Also confirm whether you'd like the SKU lines consolidated (single-line for support subscription) or split — we’ll mirror whatever helps your ledger.
